image.characterName: E m i l i a

parameters: \c[6](One by one we followed Dr Alenius’ lead into the room, Mononeko
closing the door behind us when we were all inside.)
\c[6](We were all crammed into a small office, monitors showing various
parts of the prison lining the walls.)
\c[6](Someone sat in a large black office chair at the desk, turned
\c[6](The figure turned around, something about her was oddly familiar…)
Who the hell are you? Are you the person behind this?
I’m one of your Wardens, that’s all you need to know.
Aren’t you a bit too young to be doing this sorta thing? Where the
Same place as your victims, Wang.
Does anyone else have anything to say about me, or are you going to
Where have you been this whole time? I thought it was just the cat-
Well duhhh! I *am* the in-prison warden. Emilia isn’t even really
meant to be face-to-face with you right now… But she just *really*
And that’s the most you’ll learn about me. I don’t exactly want
to make small talk with scum like you.
…And yet you specifically went out of your way to meet with us?
Jesus Christ, how much do I need to threaten you lot before you
My crime has already been exposed, you’ve got nothing left to hold
Do you want to test that?
Let me cut to the fuckin’ point-
I ain’t all that surprised, it’s come to this… I just didn’t expect
a body this soon, especially not one of the prisoners judged as
What on earth *did* you expect-? You… You put all our loved ones
Of course someone was going to…
Did you ever think what would’ve happened if none of you voted?
It was literally the first thing I asked, you told us trying not
to vote or tying the votes was pointless.
We also told you that you had to administer those shocks… But were
there any negative consequences for disobeying?
…Chat, I think we might’ve made a tiny little blunder-
That’s-! That’s no fair! You don’t just make rules and then don’t
follow them! That’s not fair at all.
You were the ones who commodified the lives of those hostages, debating
who’s life had more value, who was better to pick-
You created the tension, the fear, amongst yourselves that pushed
We gave you a knife, you decided to use it to kill.
…No, this is bullshit. You guys wanted this to happen, you don’t
get to act like *we* fostered this environment when you’re the
people getting donations to see bodies drop.
You don’t get to push the blame and play the moral high ground
when we gave you exactly what you wanted.
This ‘holier than thou criminal scum’ charade would be more believable
if you weren’t treating this like it’s big-brother with all this
She’s right-! You can’t seriously be holding the moral high-ground
when you’re getting us to kill each other! This is just gonna paint
your whole movement in a bad light!
Mint only had to use his dad’s health insurance money how he did
‘cuz the government’s money was being spent on the ultimate program
instead of shit like free healthcare.
Isn’t that the kinda story you lot should be parading around to prove
Just further proof the whole movement is ridiculous.
Believe what you want to believe. Even if you think we created an
environment where this was bound to happen, someone has still died
and one of you is the killer.
The deaths have started and now the balls rolling, I doubt it’ll
stop… So all future motives will actually be unavoidable. You’ve
proved you really do deserve to be here, lucky you.
Which means we must have a trial.
Yeah, like uhm- is this a courtroom ‘objection’ sort of deal or
more of a court of public opinion deal?
If you get it correct, then the killer will be executed and the
rest of you will be free to continue your life within the Prison.
Yuh-huh! Nothing like a good ol’ public execution!
…What will happen if we get the wrong person, will they get executed
Duh! And so will everyone else!
What? If we screw this up *everyone* will die? That’s–
If you vote incorrectly, then the killer will be set free from the
prison and allowed to live. Meanwhile, every other prisoner will be
You… You didn’t tell us this before… Jesus-
Don’t act shocked. Every crime has a butterfly effect.
If you’re morally bankrupt enough to kill one person, I think you deserve a
few more innocent lives to weigh your conscience down.
…Even if the killer were to somehow win, how on earth could they
live with themselves knowing what they’ve done?
Some people could do it easily.
…I guess some people are just entirely desperate to get out, no
Is that everything you wanted to make us aware of?
I believe that’s it. If you have any problems with it I don’t
You all deserve to be here, regardless of how many ‘Worthy of
Redemption’ verdicts you get. So you don’t exactly deserve the
Well, whatever, keep on bringing out whatever sob-stories you can
to leech off of the audience’s pity. I’m sure Mint’s death is going
to do wonders for your verdict, Ezekiel.
You’re one to talk about leeching… How about instead of leeching
off of our pasts for shock-content and shitty stream donations you
actually make something of yourself. Seems a lot more productive
than just being pissy we’re Ultimates and you’re not.
God I hope you all die in this fucking trial.
\c[6](The Warden clicked her tongue and turned around on her chair.)
The elevator to the trial room is just through there, I suggest you
get there before we start the trial-timer.
Whatever happens, we must ensure we find the killer. We cannot let
Yeah! This won’t be the end of Taka Takahiro- I swear it!
…Not that we’ve got much of a choice, but y’know.
I’ll find out which of you bastards got Mint killed and make sure
…Okay maybe that’s being a *little* too enthusiastic about it.
Let’s just try our best to make sure we all don’t die, I’m not going
Let’s not waste anymore time, we should get going.
\c[6](One by one we all walked into the fairly cramped elevator-)
\c[6](However, just as I was about to enter… I found myself being stopped.)
Gosh! You’re so stroppy and here I was trying to be nice!
…Mint just died, Mononeko- is this really the time?
All I wanted to do was congratulate you! I dunno how you did it-
but you’ve quickly become a fan favourite!
Your popularity has been skyrocketing lately! It’s like everyone and
their grandma ships you with someone… Or has some weird ‘found-family’
headcanon deal going on with you and another prisoner.
I’ll be honest, I didn’t believe in you, but you’ve really surprised me!
…But I guess it’s not *too* hard to get popular when you’re a
conventionally attractive, slightly mentally ill twink.
Eitherway! It would *suck* for our numbers if you were to bite the
dust, or if the stream ended here with the killer getting away with
it… Soooo- I thought I’d give you a little help on this case!
Bitch, it’s a dark-web red-room. I don't give a shit about integrity.
Just don’t tell the others, I don’t want them getting jealous~
…This feels like being a teacher’s pet, I don’t think there’s much
for them to be jealous of.
God, you could be a *bit* more grateful.
Anyway, have fun in the trial! Don’t die!
If you die even with me helping you then that would be really
\c[11][Due to your Popularity Mononeko has decided to help you in this
trial! Some Mini Games will be slightly easier!]
\c[6](I stepped into the cramped elevator, tension was high in the air.)
\c[6](No one dared to break it by speaking, all of us stayed silent-
\c[6](Even with just one person gone it felt like so much was lost…)
\c[6](It was strange thinking that if we ever went back into this elevator,
only ten of us would ascend back to the Prison.)
\c[6](One fifth of us would be gone in an instant…)
\c[6](I couldn’t believe one of us had bitten the bullet and killed someone…)
\c[6](...It was weird, Ismene being a murderer was shocking but-)
\c[6](I could always distance myself from it.)
\c[6](It always felt so far away, impersonal, something unrelated to
me… If I wanted to, I could deny to myself she even did it.)
\c[6](That’s horrible. Perhaps that makes me a bad person…)
\c[6](...But this all felt far more real.)
\c[6](...Maybe because I knew Mint. Because I felt like something was
missing, that I regretted not spending more time with him… Maybe
that’s why I couldn’t detach myself as much.)
\c[6](I could play detective all I liked, try to process everything as
if it’s a murder-plot I need to unravel the narrative of logistically…
\c[6](But when it came time to find and face who took his life with
\c[6](I couldn’t stare away from the reality in front of me.)
\c[6](The two of us slowly walked into the elevator together, we didn’t
say a word to each other as we ascended up into the warden’s office again.)
\c[6](I would have tried to say something, but all the words had been
\c[6](He really was gone. So was Mint.)
\c[6](The silence persisted as we walked through the warden’s office,
I never noticed how little we had to talk about with each other when
\c[6](But just before we left, a voice spoke up.)
\c[6](We both turned to face the Warden, who stayed sitting at her desk.)
…I wanted to clarify something, I don’t want there being any misconceptions.
While everything else in the execution was real, the corpses of his
…Not that he would’ve been able to tell the difference, but still.
Why are you telling us this..?
If it was up to me we wouldn’t involve anyone else aside from you lot.
I don’t care about hurting Ultimates, but I have no interest in fucking
up the lives of regular people.
\c[6](Then all those hostages… Why did you?)
Ultimates will always be scum to me, nothing can change that. This isn’t
me giving either of you special treatment-
…But they’re corrupted by their positions, it isn’t something inherently
Those related to them are typically nothing like them, they aren’t half
as wicked, at worst they’re just complicit.
I’m living proof. My dad was an Ultimate. I’d rather burn this place
to the ground than become anything like that man.
\c[6](I saw Ismene bite her lip, her fists clenched by her sides…
It was clear she was holding herself back from saying something.)
\c[6](I couldn’t say I entirely blamed her.)
\c[6](Ismene quickly walked out, clearly wanting to leave before she said
anything that could potentially get her punished.)
\c[6](All I got out of Ismene was a muttered ‘hypocrite’ as we continued
our silent journey to the cells.)
